cues: The form is free verse, with no rhyme and no metre in either language, so the shape on the page is de Burgos's own.
Six stanzas of nine, three, ten, six, one and eight lines.
The short stanza two is the bruise; the single line of stanza five is the climax, standing alone.
And the structure is circular: the last stanza repeats the first, and ends differently.
